implicit-tilted-ellipse.alt: The tilted ellipse x² + xy + y² = 7 in crimson on axes from −4 to 4. A dashed vertical line x = 1 meets it at (1, 2) and (1, −3), so y is not a function of x. A blue tangent line at (1, 2) has slope −4/5.

implicit-cubic-curve.alt: The curve y³ − xy = 6 in two pieces: an upper piece rising through (1, 2) and (7, 3), and a lower piece below the x-axis with its leftmost point near x = 6.2. The curve never meets the x-axis.
